title: FLOW.md/README: secoes 1 e 2.5 ainda descrevem orchestrator/next pane abrindo /cam-next
description:
Resíduo de doc staleness fora do escopo do CAM-4 US-002 (que reconciliou só as secoes 4/7/8 do FLOW.md). Pontos pendentes, descobertos no review do CAM-4 (2026-06-13): (1) FLOW.md secao 1 mermaid (~linha 46) diz 'cam next
abre pane: /cam-next' e a prose (~linha 75) diz 'o loop emite COMPLETE' (modelo stop-hook morto). (2) FLOW.md secao 2.5 mermaid (~linha 162) diz 'pane 0.0: orchestrator (claude /cam-next; ao sair: kill-session)'. (3) README.md (~linha 158) diz 'Pane 0.0 (left): orchestrator claude process running /cam-next'. A realidade (buildOrchestratorPaneCommand + buildOrchestratorBootPrompt em src/commands/run.ts): o pane 0.0 roda `claude --permission-mode bypassPermissions --session-id ''`, que carrega o subagent-orchestrator.md, NAO /cam-next. FIX: corrigir os 3 pontos pro comando real do orchestrator pane + supervisor. Doc-only, sem em-dash. Verificar contra src/commands/run.ts.
